import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib import rcParams

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (16, 10)
rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# Create DataFrame from provided data
data = {
    'ID': [5524, 2174, 4141, 6182, 5324],
    'Year_Birth': [1957, 1954, 1965, 1984, 1981],
    'Education': ['Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'PhD'],
    'Marital_Status': ['Single', 'Single', 'Together', 'Together', 'Married'],
    'Income': [58138.0, 46344.0, 71613.0, 26646.0, 58293.0],
    'Kidhome': [0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
    'Teenhome': [0, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    'Dt_Customer': ['04-09-2012', '08-03-2014', '21-08-2013', '10-02-2014', '19-01-2014'],
    'Recency': [58, 38, 26, 26, 94],
    'MntWines': [635, 11, 426, 11, 173],
    'MntFruits': [88, 1, 49, 4, 43],
    'MntMeatProducts': [546, 6, 127, 20, 118],
    'MntFishProducts': [172, 2, 111, 10, 46],
    'MntSweetProducts': [88, 1, 21, 3, 27],
    'MntGoldProds': [88, 6, 42, 5, 15],
    'NumDealsPurchases': [3, 2, 1, 2, 5],
    'NumWebPurchases': [8, 1, 8, 2, 5],
    'NumCatalogPurchases': [10, 1, 2, 0, 3],
    'NumStorePurchases': [4, 2, 10, 4, 6],
    'NumWebVisitsMonth': [7, 5, 4, 6, 5],
    'AcceptedCmp3': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp4': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp5': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education')
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)')

# 2. Product Spending Comparison
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
product_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
product_totals = df[product_cols].sum()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(product_totals)))
bars = ax2.bar(product_totals.index, product_totals.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Amount Spent')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Purchase Channels
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_means = df[purchase_cols].mean()
ax3.pie(purchase_means.values, labels=purchase_means.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Average Purchases by Channel')

# 4. Customer Demographics
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(range(len(marital_counts))))
ax4.set_title('Customer Marital Status Distribution')

# 5. Age Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']  # Assuming current year is 2024
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=5, kde=True, ax=ax5, color='skyblue')
ax5.set_title('Customer Age Distribution')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')

# 6. Household Composition
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
child_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.bar(child_counts.index.astype(str), child_counts.values, color=['#FFD166', '#06D6A0', '#118AB2'])
ax6.set_title('Number of Children per Household')
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')

# 7. Recency vs Income
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
scatter = ax7.scatter(df['Recency'], df['Income'], c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_title('Recency vs Income (colored by Age)')
ax7.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase')
ax7.set_ylabel('Income ($)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax7, label='Age')

# 8. Campaign Response
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
response_counts = df['Response'].value_counts()
colors = ['#EF476F', '#06D6A0'] if len(response_counts) == 2 else ['#EF476F']
ax8.bar(['No Response', 'Responded'][:len(response_counts)], response_counts.values, color=colors)
ax8.set_title('Marketing Campaign Response Rate')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Customers')

plt.suptitle('Customer Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
